title: Tall whites playing 'airplanes' on the Indian Springs runways

tellings.quote: I I used to watch them play at the runways at Indian Springs Air Base on summer nights

plain: Charles Hall, a man who says he spent 1965 to 1967 at Indian Springs in Nevada alongside tall, pale beings he calls the Tall Whites, says he used to watch them play on the runways of Indian Springs Air Base on summer nights. He told podcast host Jesse Michels in 2025 that they were playing a game like airplanes there. If true, it would mean these beings were using a US military airfield as a playground right under the base's nose.
